articles.Title: SYNTHETIC ARTICLE: Genomic sampling of a synthetic respiratory pathogen in Tempe, Arizona

Passages.Text: SYNTHETIC ARTICLE: Genomic sampling of a synthetic respiratory pathogen in Tempe, Arizona
Author affiliation: Department of Synthetic Epidemiology, Example University, Phoenix, Arizona, USA.

Specimens were collected for this synthetic study in March 2026. Sample SYNLIT_01 was collected at the Kyrene Road sampling site in Tempe, Arizona on 3 March 2026. Sample SYNLIT_09 was collected at the same Kyrene Road sampling site in Tempe, Arizona on 5 March 2026 (site coordinates 33.4100, -111.9300).
Detections of the synthetic variant increased between 3 March and 12 March 2026 at the Kyrene Road site.
These results may suggest local spread, although two samples from one site cannot establish transmission. A limitation is that only one site was sampled.
[1] Example A. A previously reported cluster in Yuma, Arizona. Synthetic Journal. 2025.
